{%- doc -%} Existing blog and FAQ destinations shared by desktop, mobile, toolbar, home and footer. @param {string} location - desktop, mobile, toolbar, home or footer. @param {link[]} [menu_links] - Existing links used to avoid duplicate destinations. @param {block[]} [menu_blocks] - Existing mobile menu blocks. {%- enddoc -%} {%- liquid assign navigation_enabled = settings.ta_vie_navigation_links | default: true, allow_false: true assign home_enabled = settings.ta_vie_home_links | default: true, allow_false: true assign show_links = navigation_enabled if location == 'home' assign show_links = home_enabled elsif location == 'footer' or location == 'toolbar' assign show_links = true endif assign reading_blog = settings.ta_vie_blog if reading_blog != blank and reading_blog.url == blank assign reading_blog = blogs[settings.ta_vie_blog] endif if settings.ta_vie_blog == blank and blogs.news.url != blank assign reading_blog = blogs.news endif assign faq_page = settings.ta_vie_faq_page if faq_page != blank and faq_page.url == blank assign faq_page = pages[settings.ta_vie_faq_page] endif if settings.ta_vie_faq_page == blank assign faq_page = pages.faq if faq_page.url == blank for candidate in pages limit: 50 if candidate.template_suffix == 'faq' and candidate.url != blank assign faq_page = candidate break endif endfor endif endif capture existing_destinations render 'ta-vie-menu-destinations', links: menu_links if location == 'mobile' for menu_block in menu_blocks if menu_block.type == 'menu' or menu_block.type == 'menu-columns' assign menu_handle = menu_block.settings.mobile_menu_linklist | default: 'main-menu' render 'ta-vie-menu-destinations', links: linklists[menu_handle].links endif endfor endif endcapture assign destinations = 'blog,faq' | split: ',' assign has_missing_destination = false -%} {%- capture links_markup -%} {%- if show_links -%} {%- for destination in destinations -%} {%- liquid if destination == 'blog' assign resource = reading_blog assign link_label = settings.ta_vie_blog_label | default: 'ブログ' assign resource_type = 'blog_link' assign explicit_url = settings.ta_vie_blog_url else assign resource = faq_page assign link_label = settings.ta_vie_faq_label | default: 'よくあるご質問' assign resource_type = 'page_link' assign explicit_url = settings.ta_vie_faq_url endif assign destination_url = resource.url assign destination_id = resource.id if explicit_url != blank assign destination_url = explicit_url assign destination_id = blank endif assign already_linked = false capture url_token echo '|' | append: destination_url | append: '|' endcapture capture id_token echo '|' | append: resource_type | append: ':' | append: destination_id | append: '|' endcapture if location != 'home' if existing_destinations contains url_token assign already_linked = true elsif destination_id != blank and existing_destinations contains id_token assign already_linked = true endif endif -%} {%- if destination_url != blank and already_linked == false -%} {%- case location -%} {%- when 'desktop' -%}

preset_color_scheme_fix.trigger: FileSaveError: preset Relay requires the same color scheme IDs in every preset

navigation_links.resource_selection: Explicit URL inputs take priority over global blog/page pickers; otherwise use only actual existing news/FAQ resources, including blogs with zero articles
navigation_links.existing_menu_duplicate_check: URL and typed page/blog ID across nested links and multiple mobile menus; toolbar checks its own native menu
navigation_links.unconfigured_home_editor: Show disabled labels and setup guidance only in design mode; public unresolved destinations stay hidden
navigation_links.shopify_resource_selection: Required unless verified existing fallback resolves; actual link fields and merchant social URLs remain unconfigured; live selection unverified

homepage_structure.legacy_product_grid: Saved unchanged but disabled; no active horizontal product catalog
homepage_structure.products: Explicit curated product blocks only, initially two unselected blocks; real product title, price and URL; public empty blocks hidden with editor guidance
homepage_structure.reading: Native section Blog picker takes priority, then opted-in global blog picker, then existing news; hide publicly without published articles; editor-only setup message; 3 cards; section picker does not automatically populate global navigation
homepage_structure.entrance: One static brand introduction with a single h1, followed by the first selected product; previous autoplay hero, abstract photo columns and marquee disabled with settings retained
homepage_structure.typography: Site-wide Japanese sans mode remains current; scoped new section styles provide large product titles and 16px explanatory text
homepage_structure.actual_demo_browsing: Official Theme Store and demo HTML fetched with TLS verification; official desktop/mobile preview images inspected; interactive remote browser blocked by certificate trust approval

sequence: large main photograph and product introduction
product_chapters.desktop: Main photograph approximately 64 percent of available grid columns; next product photo placement can be reversed; media fills its column and height caps at 980px
product_chapters.mobile_and_tablet_below_990px: One column, photograph then title, introduction, price and product detail link; no reversal of reading order
product_chapters.main_photo: Explicit image preferred, otherwise real product featured_image; separate mobile image supported; contain or cover selectable
product_chapters.optional_photographs: Use-scene and detail images require explicit selection; absent photographs do not produce placeholders or repeated product images
product_chapters.copy: Manual introduction preferred; existing product description used only with an opt-in checkbox, off by default; material names and features entered per product
product_chapters.product_selection: No automatic collections.all fallback or arbitrary catalog product
product_chapters.price: Native price snippet with actual product data; no new purchase form
product_chapters.resources_current: No merchant product or photographs selected; no material composition, certification or product facts invented

site_typography.platform_limits: Local Chromium Japanese regular font verified; merchant store, macOS and Windows rendering unverified

home_story_readability.trigger: Earlier readability adjustment at screenshot width 2718px; not the new product chapter layout

footer_refinement.empty_menu_columns: Hide heading and column; preserve configured native menus
footer_refinement.resource_fallback: Opt-in actual blog/FAQ links only when native menu has no links
footer_refinement.visible_columns: Redistribute widths only when empty menu columns are hidden
footer_refinement.newsletter: Native email-only option; submission code unchanged

header_refinement.unconfigured_mobile_demo_blocks: Product and decorative demo blocks disabled with IDs retained; native socials and divider re-enabled

toolbar.multiple_languages: Preserve native localization selector and form; English must be published in Shopify
